description: Open PowerPoint (.pptx) files in an editor tab — rendered inside VS Code with thumbnails, speaker notes, search, and automatic reload when the file changes.
config.autoReload: Reload the viewer automatically when the file changes on disk.
config.defaultZoom: Zoom level used when a presentation is opened.
config.defaultZoom.fit: Fit the whole slide in the editor.
config.defaultZoom.width: Fit the slide to the editor width.
config.defaultZoom.actual: Show the slide at its actual size (100%).
config.thumbnails: Show the thumbnail sidebar when a presentation is opened.
config.notes: Controls whether the speaker notes panel is shown when a presentation is opened.
config.notes.auto: Show the panel only when the presentation contains speaker notes.
config.notes.hide: Keep the panel hidden until it is turned on from the toolbar.
